title: Work IQ: agents upload files and content to Microsoft 365
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing statements and documented policy path are supported. It distinguishes existing Work IQ controls from the planned upload capability and appropriately leaves upload-specific defaults, destinations and charges unresolved.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Why it matters; Governance controls; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft has not expressly confirmed whether the named upload capability is covered by the general MCP mutation policy.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ: Upload"; "Work IQ" MCP policy settings Microsoft Graph beta API PowerShell toggle. Opened MCP policy and SharePoint Tools: general MCP writes are covered, but neither identifies this separate upload item or its implementation.

claims.claim: The documented Work IQ MCP policy blocks mutation operations by default.
claims.quote: By default, mutation operations aren't allowed for safety. This restriction includes create, update, delete, and action requests that modify data, such as sending email.

claims.claim: The Work IQ in Copilot Studio page separately states that write operations are on by default.
claims.quote: Write operations are on by default. Your organization's permissions and policies still apply.

claims.claim: The Copilot Studio write-default statement remains subject to organisational permissions and policies.
claims.quote: Selecting a workload doesn't override your organization's permissions or policies. Write operations are on by default, subject to those permissions and policies.

claims.claim: The two cited write-default descriptions do not explain their relationship.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ" "upload" default; "Work IQ" MCP policy settings Microsoft Graph beta API PowerShell toggle. Opened policy governance and Copilot Studio Work IQ: neither reconciles its default description with the other's.
